stories.title: Trump augura buena relación con México en el T-MEC

en.title: Trump augurs good relationship with Mexico in the T-MEC
en.summary: President Donald Trump stated that the United States will maintain an excellent relationship with Mexico when asked about the future of the T-MEC trade agreement.

stories.title: Cinta sobre la “invisibilidad” de las mujeres gana el León de Oro de la Mostra de Venecia

en.title: Film about the "invisibility" of women wins the Golden Lion at the Venice Biennale
en.summary: Danish director May el-Toukhy won the Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival for Woman Unknown, a historical drama about a servant with a wartime secret during World War II.

stories.title: Atacan buque iraní cerca del Estrecho de Ormuz

en.title: Iranian vessel attacked near the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: An Iranian merchant ship was attacked near the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in one death and three injuries.

en.title: Cruz Azul struggles to defeat América 4-3 in the Young Classic
en.summary: Cruz Azul secured a victory over América in the Young Classic, though the win came with significant difficulty.

stories.title: Demuestran Cruz Azul y América lo que es un Clásico

en.title: Cruz Azul and América demonstrate what a Classic is
en.summary: Cruz Azul defeated América 4-3 in an intense match, though the team had opportunities to win by a larger margin and faced pressure late in the game.

en.summary: Coverage of the matchday 8 encounter between Cruz Azul and América during the 2028 Apertura tournament in Liga MX.

stories.title: Monterrey y Tigres firman empate sin goles en el Clásico Regio número 143

en.title: Monterrey and Tigres sign scoreless draw in the 143rd Clásico Regio
en.summary: Monterrey and Tigres played to a 0-0 tie in their 143rd Clásico Regio match, leaving fans disappointed with the result.

stories.title: Se mantiene la Contingencia Ambiental por ozono en la CDMX y el Valle de México

en.title: Environmental Contingency due to ozone maintained in Mexico City and the Valley of Mexico
en.summary: An environmental contingency remains in effect for Mexico City and surrounding areas due to ozone levels, with air quality information to be issued tomorrow.

stories.title: Dan Rayados y Tigres un Clásico pobre y sin goles

en.title: Rayados and Tigres play a poor Clásico with no goals
en.summary: Monterrey and Tigres ended their Clásico Regio match in a 0-0 draw without excitement, with both teams remaining outside playoff contention.

stories.title: Un proyectil de origen desconocido impacta contra un buque en el estrecho de Ormuz

en.title: A projectile of unknown origin impacts a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: A ship was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, occurring amid ongoing concerns about commercial navigation safety in the region.

stories.title: Continúa Fase 1 de Contingencia Ambiental por Ozono en la ZMVM; se mantiene el doble Hoy no Circula

en.title: Phase 1 of Environmental Contingency for Ozone continues in ZMVM; double Hoy no Circula remains in effect
en.summary: Environmental authorities maintained air pollution restrictions in Mexico City's metropolitan zone to reduce public exposure to contaminated air and protect health.

stories.title: América estrena refuerzos ante Cruz Azul: ¿a qué hora y dónde ver el Clásico Joven?

en.title: América debuts reinforcements against Cruz Azul: what time and where to watch the Clásico Joven?
en.summary: América enters Matchday 8 as undefeated leaders, while Cruz Azul attempts to stop them and improve their standings in the Apertura 2026 tournament.

stories.title: ¿Abren los bancos el 15 y 16 de septiembre? No todos operan igual

en.title: Do Banks Open on September 15 and 16? Not All Operate the Same
en.summary: Banks will provide limited services on September 15 and 16 during the national holidays. Customer service options through ATMs and branches will vary by institution.

stories.title: Trump no contempla salir del T-MEC y promete una excelente relación con México, pero golpea a Canadá

en.title: Trump Does Not Contemplate Leaving USMCA and Promises Excellent Relations with Mexico, but Targets Canada
en.summary: Trump indicated he does not plan to withdraw from USMCA and stated he will maintain positive relations with Mexico. Simultaneously, he raised new complaints against Canada during the trade agreement review.

stories.title: Este seguro escolar gratuito cubre hasta 40,000 pesos a estudiantes, ¿cómo funciona y quién puede usarlo?

en.title: This Free School Insurance Covers Up to 40,000 Pesos for Students—How Does It Work and Who Can Use It?
en.summary: A free insurance program provides coverage of up to 40,000 pesos to students for school-related accidents. Protection is subject to specific conditions and does not cover all circumstances.

stories.title: La CLABE no desaparece, pero el Banco de México cambiará la forma de realizar transferencias

en.title: CLABE will not disappear, but Mexico's Central Bank will change the way transfers are made
en.summary: Mexico's Central Bank will modify the bank transfer process without eliminating the CLABE system. Financial institutions have until December 2026 to adapt their systems to the changes, which include standardizing the mobile app experience for transfers.

stories.title: Porsche deja ir a Bugatti y destina parte de la venta a pagar pensiones

en.title: Porsche divests from Bugatti and allocates sale proceeds toward pension payments
en.summary: Porsche sold Bugatti as part of a strategic shift aimed at improving profitability and cash flow in a more demanding market, with some proceeds directed to pension obligations.
